title: Explainable Transformer Models for Clinical Prediction Tasks on Structured Electronic Health Records
abstract: arXiv:2608.20315v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predictive models over structured electronic health records (EHRs) remain central to machine learning for healthcare, but few have jointly emphasized quantitative laboratory information and interpretability with respect to input medical events. We present BERT-LER, a BERT-style model for coded EHR timelines pretrained and fine-tuned from a de-identified EHR dataset of 75 million patients, that encodes laboratory test results as discrete tokens while retaining graded information through percentile-based binning, paired with Integrated Gradients for token-level attributions grounded in the input EHR sequence. We benchmark our approach on the public EHRShot benchmark suite and on an asthma severity progression study based on real-world data. translated_title: 面向结构化电子健康记录临床预测任务的可解释Transformer模型
translated_abstract: 基于结构化电子健康记录（EHRs）的预测模型仍然是医疗机器学习领域的核心，但很少有模型同时强调定量实验室信息和针对输入医疗事件的可解释性。我们提出了BERT-LER，一种用于编码EHR时间线的BERT风格模型，该模型在包含7500万患者的去标识化EHR数据集上进行预训练和微调，将实验室检测结果编码为离散标记，同时通过基于百分位的分箱保留分级信息，并结合集成梯度方法，提供基于输入EHR序列的标记级归因。我们在公开的EHRShot基准套件以及基于真实数据的哮喘严重程度进展研究上评估了我们的方法。这通过将实验室值表示和可解释性统一在单一框架中，解决了EHR基础风格建模中的方法论空白，同时评估了预测性能是否得到提升。
tldr: 本文提出BERT-LER，一种统一实验室值表示与可解释性的BERT风格EHR模型，通过百分位分箱编码和集成梯度归因，在预测性能与解释性上填补了方法空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BERT-LER, a BERT-style EHR model that unifies laboratory value representation and explainability via percentile-based binning and Integrated Gradients, filling a methodological gap while assessing predictive performance.
